rationale: Replaced nine generic, dead, or misleading controls with one literal and recoverable scene-profile axis.; Added five immutable exact-public and eleven mutually exclusive transform-composition profiles.; Implemented an exact input-pure oracle for row-zero command reading, color-blind regions, bbox ordering, rectangular cropping, and sequential D4 transforms.; Covered canonical identity compositions instead of rejecting them as invisible degenerates.; Added explicit first-region/external-decoy and enclosed-detached-cell lessons that mirror the canonical component-plus-subgrid interaction.; Added fail-closed structural and semantic validation, deterministic fresh returns, global-RNG isolation, unknown-override rejection, and adversarial focused tests.; Pinned canonical rule hash 1157bcb457e5 and synchronized grounded plus base raw/target authorities byte-for-byte.
summary: Read every nonzero value in row zero from left to right. Find all color-blind 4-connected nonzero regions, keep those whose bounding-box top is below row zero, and choose the one with smallest bounding-box top then left. Crop that full rectangle from the original grid. Starting with the crop, apply each command sequentially: 2 rotate clockwise, 3 rotate 180 degrees, 4 transpose, 5 flip left-right, and 6 flip up-down. Return the final crop, even when the composition is identity.
